profile_md: Leeds has several verified employer-linked group project routes, distributed across schools rather than run through one university-wide scheme. The widest are two Discovery-eligible or central routes: LUBS3013 Enterprise Consultancy (final-year undergraduates from across the University work in teams on consultancy briefs from small businesses and social enterprises, graded partly by a group client report) and the Leeds Global Industry Programme (multidisciplinary teams of 5-8 taught postgraduates produce a consultancy report for a live company brief; EPS students take an eight-week embedded equivalent in teams of five). Within degrees, the MEng Team Project (MECH5080M, 45 credits, groups of 3-6 mentored by industry collaborators acting as customers) is compulsory in mechanical-engineering MEng programmes, and the civil engineering Year 4 design project has industrial partners acting as client (undated evidence). In arts and humanities, FOAH5000M Civic Researcher has interdisciplinary groups negotiating briefs with Leeds cultural and third-sector bodies, with external leads on the assessment panel; the Arts Management MA has a partner-brief group module. Business school routes include the MBA Consulting Challenge and LUBS3990 Innovation Thinking and Practice (partner-set challenges pitched to industry panels), but current delivery is not confirmed for either. Several individual live-client routes (MSc Management Consulting, MSc Sustainability and Consultancy) fail the group criterion. Uncertain: client identity for the design marketing module, external role in Computer Science and Chemical Engineering group projects, and participation volumes, which are mostly unpublished.
gaps: Further departmental instances likely (Electronic Engineering, Aerospace/Mechatronics variants, Geography/Environment, Education, Cerebra pro bono programme, School of Media and Communication, Computer Science industrial MSc projects). Not searched in detail: Physics/Chemistry/Biology group projects other than via Enterprise Consultancy; Maths/Statistics MSc projects (co-supervised individual projects found, group unclear). Participation numbers mostly unpublished; several pages undated so current delivery uncertain for S5, S7, S8, S9. Search budget exceeded the ~40 target (about 50 searches) to cover six areas.
